turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dadaji? It is me, Rohan. I am calling from a friend's phone because mine smashed.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Rohan? Which Rohan? My nephew is in Bangalore, not using a friend's phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I came to Pune for a project and had a small accident with a bike. I am okay but the police are here and it is very stressful.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my god, what happened? Are you hurt? Where in Pune are you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am just shaken up, Mr. Sharma. Please, do not tell my parents yet because they will panic and scold me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But I must call your father. We need to know which police station you are in.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, please, just for today. I just need to pay twelve thousand rupees to the owner of the bike to settle it quickly or they will lock me up.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand? That is a lot of money. Why can't you call your brother?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He is not picking up. Can you please send it via UPI right now so I can leave this place?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know how to do this quickly. Let me think about it first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dadaji, please hurry. The officer is asking for the payment now or he will take me to the station.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, your voice sounds a bit different today. Are you really Rohan?
